notes.content: app.js Cart: serverga yozish faqat login qilgan foydalanuvchida bo'lishi kerak. API.post/del/re req'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri _srv'ga argument qilib bermang (u har doim fetch yuboradi, mehmon uchun ham 401 chiqadi). To'g'ri shakl: this._srv(() => API.post(...)). _srv(fn) ichida if(!state.user) return; fn().then(...).

Backend auth: internal/auth/password.go Iterations=600000 (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, Go stdlib) amalda login/register 2-4s oladi (CGO_ENABLED=0, SHA HW ext yo'q). Bu login endpoint'i sekin va auth rate limit amalda ishlamaydi (token bucket replenish so'rov tezligiga yetadi). Bu ma'lum mahsulot cheklovi; e2e-test.mjs 13-qadam shu sababli 429 kutmaydi (aslida test nomuvofiqligi ham bor).
